 Key Biscayne faces another wet and windy day Wednesday, with showers and thunderstorms likely, locally heavy rainfall possible and gusty winds, particularly during the morning hours.
 Today's high will be around 78 degrees, with east winds at 20 to 30 mph. Additional rainfall of a quarter to half an inch is possible, with locally higher amounts during thunderstorms.
 The National Weather Service in Miami has maintained a Flood Watch through Thursday evening, as periods of heavy rain could cause flash flooding in low-lying and poorly drained areas. Residents should remain alert for water accumulating on streets and in parking areas, particularly during heavier downpours.
 Tonight, cloudy skies, showers and scattered thunderstorms, with a low around 74 degrees and east-southeast winds at 10 to 20 mph.
 Thursday offers some improvement, with a shower or two possible early before skies become partly cloudy during the afternoon. The high will be around 79 degrees, with east winds at 10 to 20 mph and a 30% chance of rain.
